name: whisper.cpp
summary: Transcribe audio with a local speech-recognition engine.
description: A C/C++ implementation of Whisper for speech-to-text workflows. This candidate is a command-line engine rather than a certified turnkey desktop application.

license.notes: Upstream license indicator only; redistribution, dependency notices and any model/asset licenses await legal review.

review.notes: Researched upstream documentation only. Not installed, executed, packaged, security reviewed or certified by RepoReady.

requirements.platform: Upstream targets Windows; the exact Windows version, architecture and compatibility matrix have not been selected or tested.
requirements.hardware: Whisper model files must be downloaded separately; CPU/GPU performance and RAM depend on model and build.
requirements.disk: Unknown for a RepoReady distribution. Measure installer, installed files, working data and optional downloads before approval.
requirements.modelDownloads: Separate model files and their licenses require review; no model or download size has been approved.
requirements.network: Model downloads require network access; local transcription can process files without an external API.
requirements.privacy: Local file processing is supported upstream; microphone access and any server integration need review.
requirements.apiCharges: No remote speech API is required for local transcription; optional integrations can have separate costs.

distribution.notes: Upstream distribution is research context. Independent use without RepoReady or a managed-runtime requirement must be certified for a specific version and artifact before any download is enabled.

limitations: Candidate draft only: no RepoReady release version, test date or approved artifact exists.
Model output can be inaccurate; evaluate suitability and licensing before relying on it.
Installation, updating, uninstalling and recovery have not been validated on Windows.
mediaNotes: No reviewed screenshot is published. Capture or license authentic media with accessible text and provenance before release publication.
setupNotes: Unknown until a package is selected and a clean-machine setup is reviewed. No installation instructions are authorized for this draft.
updateNotes: Unknown until the selected package's update and rollback behavior is tested.
